title: SCRT men’s & unisex — natural materials only
summary: Audited all 358 currently published SCRT products. 199 eligible wearable products across 178 style cards pass the strict disclosed-material gate; 39 disclose manufactured fibers and 18 lack complete enough composition evidence. Women’s-only, gender-ambiguous, and non-wearable products are excluded.

recommendation.title: 199 of 358 published products passed
recommendation.text: Men’s-specific and gender-neutral wearables only. Every disclosed fiber/material must be natural; polyester, nylon/polyamide, acrylic, elastane/spandex, viscose/rayon, lyocell, acetate, modal, polyurethane and other synthetics fail.
recommendation.test: Sorted by observed USD price, lowest first. Each card uses official SCRT images and links to the exact SCRT product page.

evidenceNote: The complete first-party audit reconciles 358 products: 199 pass, 39 fail for disclosed manufactured fibers, 18 require composition review, 100 are non-wearable, 1 is women’s-only, and 1 is gender-ambiguous.
caveat: Classification is based on SCRT’s published composition, not laboratory analysis. Neutral products are treated as unisex only when SCRT publishes no women’s-only designation; unlisted thread, ink, hardware, coatings, trims, and minor components may still be manufactured.
